image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

## 1) Chart type

  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:

- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

|---|---|---|

| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |

raw_comment: The graph represents all the countries that signed the Paris Agreement. Which is about 192 states. The first graph is a real eye-opener in terms of these countries actually meeting the goals that were set in that agreement. Out of all of the categories that need drastic improvement is electric vehicles and battery storage. All categories are behind in terms of the goals but electric vehicles and battery storage are about ten million metric tons behind when you compare 2040 under current policies and the Paris-compatible scenario. The graph showing where these materials are processed is dominated by China. The highest being rare earths at 90% production, which makes a lot of sense considering they produce the majority of rare earth material. A good name for this graph could be: "Paris Agreement Countries Involvement in Meeting The Goals"

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization of horizontal stacked bar charts**
  - Left panel: horizontal stacked bars showing projected demand totals by scenario/year.
  - Right panels: horizontal stacked percentage bars showing production shares and processing shares by mineral.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Stacking**: All bars are stacked to show composition within totals.
- **Small multiples / grouped panels**:
  - One left panel for demand.
  - Two right-side panels: **production** and **processing**.
- **Categorical rows**:
  - Left panel rows are scenarios/time points.
  - Right panels rows are minerals.
- No faceting grid is explicitly drawn, but the separate titled sections function as **panel-based small multiples**.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / scenario (2020, 2040 under current policies, 2040 Paris-compatible scenario) | Temporal + categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Demand amount (millions of metric tons) | Quantitative | Bar length / position on x-axis in left panel |
| Demand use category (Electricity networks, Wind and solar, Electric vehicles and battery storage, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of stacked segments in left panel, text labels inside/near segments |
| Mineral (Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Rare earths, Lithium) | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels in right panels |
| Share of production (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in top-right panel |
| Producing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in top-right panel |
| Share of processing (%) | Quantitative | Bar segment length / position on x-axis in bottom-right panel |
| Processing country | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and segment labels in bottom-right panel |
| Panel/topic (Demand vs Produced vs Processed) | Categorical/nominal | Separate titled sections / panel layout |
